notes.title: JetFly Version 3.0.0
notes.notes:
In this version we describe and show basic idea and concept of game
and we Create DLC Version of game.
So let's get to the details:
We start with the "Improvements"
1.Game Elements (ADDS AND CHANGES)
2.Game Mode (Time Attack for mission , Arcade Mode)
3.We add missions 
4.We add power UP's for player
5.We add Levels (in DLC version)

note:
In DLC version we add more missions and Levels,
but DLC version will appear Later
